features.title: Data events
features.expected_behavior: Enable registers a CO2 custom-sensor DataReport event listener; with no sensor present the status shows 'No custom sensor found'. Disable is greyed until Enable succeeds. CO2 level shows 'No data' until a report arrives.

features.title: Polling
features.expected_behavior: Get CO2 level polls the custom sensor for its latest reading; with no sensor present the status shows 'No custom sensor found'. CO2 level shows 'No data'.
